points.description: Correct final answer of 2 good days left, with every step mathematically valid (e.g., the 30-day totals leave 4 good and 2 neutral days among the last six; after good, neutral, good, two good days remain).

rubric.notes: Full marks require the correct final answer and a fully valid method. A single invalid step or an incorrect final answer earns no marks. Equivalent correct reasoning is accepted.
